rule: Owner, 2026-10-25: a character who appears once looks the same in every later video (Moses after 100 videos is the same Moses). Every prompt that shows a character carries its `look` word for word (plus one `wardrobe` variant), Agnes clips pass its approved reference images (reference mode, up to 5), and FLUX stills reuse its seed. A character is used only when its status is APPROVED (Claude reviewed the reference sheet). God the Father is never shown as a person: light, wind, voice (reverence; the KJV text carries Him).
